data.content_ref: inline:The conclusion that the book has 300 pages depends on the exhaustive allocation of 189 digits to pages 1–99, which reduces to the identity that 9·1 + 90·2 = 189 before any 3-digit pages are considered; it is refuted if the 189-digit subtotal for single- and double-digit pages is miscounted (e.g., off-by-one), since the remainder 603 would be invalid and the final total would not be 300.
